notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 ordinary attribute-ownership surface. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies ownership queries, assumption offers, negotiated and If Wanted acquisition/divestiture, If Available acquisition, unconditional divestiture, denial, cancellation, callback delivery, invalid-handle failures, and pre-connect/pre-join service boundaries without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador ordinary attribute-ownership services with FederateAmbassador ownership callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador ownership declarations
